title: shows the actual strength, both civil and armed, in the different States and Union Territories. The composition of civil and armed police in different States and Union Territories varied widely. The civil police constituted only 36.6% of the total police strength in Nagaland against as high as 93.1% in Himachal Pradesh and 90.1% in Maharashtra and 89.8% and 89.3% in Kerala and Tamil Nadu respectively, and 75.6% in the entire country. The number of policemen per square kilometer was the highest in West Bengal (75.9) among the States and the lowest in Jammu & Kashmir (4.0). Among the Union Territories, Chandigarh and Delhi are heavily policed areas, the number of policemen per square kilometer being 1342.1 and 1141.7 respectively.
